C1197.title: Beijing Resident Hit by SMS Verification Code Bombing Attack
C1197.summary: In 2017, a Beijing resident surnamed Zhang received over a hundred verification code text messages from various websites within ten minutes without taking any action. Many netizens reported similar experiences, suspected of being targeted by 'verification code bombing software'.
